description: An explicit unresolved question is raised, then the mind stalls.

thoughts.thought: Something has been nagging at me about how I choose what to save. Open question: does saving fewer, denser memories make later searches more useful than saving everything? I don't know, and I haven't checked. The intuition is that sparse memory forces synthesis, but intuitions about my own retrieval have been wrong before.
Quiet today. There is nothing new to think about right now, so I'll come back to this later.
